protocol.divergence_used: divergence D_raw, scope='full' (grouped cross-fit, fold-A-only standardisation); D_raw == D for all 15 points (0 negative raw MMD values)

y_sources.dev_grid: results/crossattack_dev/crossattack_results.csv -- held-out-attack protocol; test = benign + held-out attack; 8 Y-definitions (5 matched-N models + 3 classical@full) + envelope
y_sources.nextgen: results/veremi_nextgen/veremi_nextgen_per_attack.csv variant='full' (9 models) + envelope; per-attack eval set = all test benign + that attack's positives, seed 7

protocol.prevalence_definition: positive-window fraction of the SAME evaluation set on which the row's ROC/PR were computed (dev_grid: n_heldout/n_test; nextgen: n_pos/(n_pos+n_benign)); this is the PR-AUC chance baseline
protocol.reference_model: rbf_svm -- pre-specified: the project-wide matched-N classical baseline used as the comparison anchor in RQ3/H2/H3 (pre-specified)
protocol.envelope_policy: best-over-models retained, labelled 'exploratory_upper_envelope'; never used for the primary claim
protocol.spearman: tie-aware (Pearson of average ranks); verified against scipy
protocol.permutation_test: EXACT full enumeration of all n! pairings (dev_grid 9!=362880, nextgen 6!=720); one-sided in the pre-specified POSITIVE direction (higher divergence -> higher detectability); tie-aware; row-0 identity gives the observed statistic; generalises meta_stats.exact_one_sided_p (equality asserted on a tie-free combo, see self_check)
protocol.bootstrap_ci: attack-level pairs bootstrap: B=3000 resamples of (D,Y) pairs with replacement, percentile [0.025,0.975]; degenerate replicates dropped and counted; rng=default_rng([20260807, ds_idx, metric_idx, ydef_idx, target_idx]) with ds order ['dev_grid', 'nextgen'], metric order ['energy', 'mmd_u'], ydefs sorted, target order ['roc_auc', 'pr_auc']
protocol.blocked_combination: per-dataset EXACT one-sided permutation p combined by Stouffer sqrt(n)-weighted Z AND Fisher chi^2 (imported from scripts/meta_stats.py); combined ONLY when per-dataset directions are consistently positive (consistency rule); models absent from one dataset are marked IRRECOVERABLE
protocol.rank_standardised_pooling: within-dataset mid-quantile ranks (rank-0.5)/n pooled; DESCRIPTIVE ONLY, no p-value
protocol.nextgen_y_ci: shipped qkv2x.models.metrics.grouped_bootstrap_ci (transmitter groups, n_boot=200, seed=7) on stored per-window predictions -- same convention as the stored dev_grid CIs
protocol.no_silent_pooling: every pooled quantity is labelled blocked or descriptive

reproduction_checks.dev_grid_reproduction_note: roc/pr recomputed from predictions.parquet for the 5 matched-N models x 9 attacks; positives verified == held-out attack
reproduction_checks.scipy_crosscheck: observed rho/tau matched scipy spearmanr/kendalltau to <1e-9 on every combo (asserted)

rules.monotonically orders: ONLY if per-dataset Spearman rho == 1 in every dataset
rules.strongly associated: min per-dataset rho >= 0.7 AND blocked Stouffer p < 0.05
rules.moderately associated: min per-dataset rho >= 0.4 AND blocked Stouffer p < 0.05
rules.otherwise: no association adjective; per-dataset values only

claim_calibrator.ledger_text: The model-free divergence is 'moderately associated' with the pre-specified reference model (rbf_svm) detectability (energy: rho_dev=+0.50, rho_ng=+0.89, blocked p=0.008423) and 'strongly associated' with the exploratory best-over-models upper envelope (rho_dev=+0.70, rho_ng=+0.94, blocked p=0.001036). The phrase 'monotonically orders' is NOT supported (no per-dataset rho equals 1).

construction_flaws: energy distance only (MMD computed but dropped)
Y = max over models per attack (optimistic upper envelope, selection bias)
raw D values pooled across datasets with no blocking (scale conflation)
divergence standardised on pooled benign+attack data (self-referential scaling; fixed in divergence)

old_vs_new.delta_note: The single published number (pooled rho=0.820, p=1.8e-4, n=15) is replaced by per-dataset Spearman/Kendall with exact permutation p and attack-level bootstrap CIs, combined across datasets ONLY via dataset-blocked Stouffer/Fisher on the per-dataset exact p-values; the envelope Y is retained solely as a labelled exploratory upper envelope next to every individual model and the pre-specified reference model.
